name: OpenSpec Board
description: Kanban board for OpenSpec spec-driven development: every change by stage with task progress, next step, ticket and GitHub pull requests. Apply and Finish send /opsx:apply, a finish check or your own command to the Claude Code or Codex agent of the change's own workspace, or start that workspace.
